Welcome to PortJeep. We are deeply committed to maintaining the trust and confidence of our personnel. This Privacy Policy outlines our comprehensive practices regarding the collection, processing, and protection of your personal information. Our priority is to ensure that your data is handled with the highest level of security while you manage your daily schedules and professional duties. By utilizing the PortJeep platform, you acknowledge and agree to the data management practices described herein.

To provide a seamless transport management experience, we collect specific data essential for our operational workflow:

• Personal Identity: Your full legal name, employee identification number, and professional profile settings.
• Contact Details: Your registered mobile phone number and corporate email address for account security and critical updates.
• Operational Logs: Daily duty schedules, shift assignments, and vehicle operation logs.
• Financial Records: Daily collection reports, remittance summaries, and official transaction data.
• Security Credentials: Encrypted login metadata and biometric fingerprint authentication status.
• Technical Analytics: Device identifiers and application performance logs to ensure system stability and provide maintenance.

The data we collect is used strictly to facilitate PortJeep operations and enhance service efficiency:

• To coordinate and manage personnel duty schedules and equipment assignments.
• To securely process, verify, and archive daily financial remittances.
• To deliver essential communications, including security alerts and operational announcements.
• To provide responsive technical support and troubleshoot application performance issues.
• To ensure full compliance with internal corporate audits and local transport regulatory requirements.

PortJeep maintains a strict policy against the sale or unauthorized trade of your personal information. Data is shared only with authorized management personnel and relevant regulatory bodies as mandated by law. We employ industry-leading security measures, including advanced encryption standards and secure authentication protocols, to safeguard your information from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure.

In accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (R.A. 10173), you are entitled to exercise your rights as a data subject, including the right to access, review, and request corrections to your personal information. Should you have any inquiries or wish to update your records, please coordinate with the PortJeep administration office.

For any privacy-related inquiries or to report data concerns, please reach us through the following formal channels:

• Email: support@portjeep.ph
• Office: Brgy, 187 Sitio Hulo, Bagong Buhay Ave, Sapang Palay, Proper, SJDM, Bulacan

By accessing, installing, or using the PortJeep application, you enter into a legally binding agreement with PortJeep management. These Terms and Conditions govern your professional use of the platform. You acknowledge that you have read and understood these terms in their entirety. If you do not agree to these conditions, you must discontinue use of the application immediately.

Access to the PortJeep application is strictly reserved for active personnel and authorized administrative staff. Use is contingent upon your current employment status. Unauthorized access by third parties is strictly prohibited and may result in immediate termination of access, disciplinary measures, or legal action.

You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You agree to accept full responsibility for all activities conducted under your account. Any suspicion of unauthorized access or security breach must be reported to the IT department immediately to prevent potential data loss or operational disruption.

All financial data, collection reports, and remittance summaries submitted through the app are considered official corporate records. Accuracy is non-negotiable. Any attempt to falsify records or misreport daily collections constitutes a major breach of PortJeep operational policy and will lead to severe disciplinary consequences.

The duty schedules published within the application are official directives. Personnel are required to adhere strictly to these assignments to ensure service reliability and operational efficiency. Any necessary deviations from the assigned schedule must be formally approved by the office management in advance.

Users are prohibited from engaging in any activity that interferes with the integrity of the application. This includes attempting to bypass security features, reverse-engineer the software, or use the application for any unauthorized, illegal, or non-work-related purposes.

The PortJeep application, including its source code, design elements, logos, and all proprietary content, is the exclusive property of PortJeep. No part of this application may be reproduced or distributed without express written consent from management.

PortJeep reserves the right to suspend or terminate your access to the application at any time, without prior notice, for violations of these terms, breach of company policy, or upon the cessation of your professional engagement with the company.

If you require technical assistance, account support, or clarification on these terms, please reach us through the following:

• Email: support@portjeep.ph
• Office: Brgy, 187 Sitio Hulo, Bagong Buhay Ave, Sapang Palay, Proper, SJDM, Bulacan
